people.name: Joshbekashah
people.line: A son of Heman, a musician in David's time

translations.web: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

translations.kjv: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
